prompt: Your organization wants agents to operate autonomously but with human oversight for high-risk actions. Which configuration approach best achieves this?
explanation: Correct answer: C) Plan and implement graduated autonomy levels with guardrails based on risk

options.text: Disable all human intervention to maximize delivery speed
Require human approval for every single agent action
Plan and implement graduated autonomy levels with guardrails based on risk
Allow agents to self-determine when human approval is needed
